board_guard.forbidden_note: MX25L4005A is the 512KB SuperIO chip. Never flash it.

entries.description: The proven community modded BIOS everyone runs on BC-250: unlocks chipset menus, dynamic VRAM allocation (set 512MB dynamic), and CPU core configuration. Curated by Fanalogy as the default recommendation.
entries.name: Fanalogy BC-250 BIOS — P3.00 Chipset Menu
entries.status: available - sha256 verified from the real upstream file 2026-10-23; catalog minisign signature still pending (key not yet generated)

entries.description: Fanalogy's own preset build on the modded P3.00 Chipset family: all 8 cores / 16 threads unlocked persistently, Nirvana boot logo, Fanalogy defaults baked in (IOMMU Disabled, VRAM 512MB Dynamic). This is the Flash & Pray target (docs/FLASH-AND-PRAY.md). The GPU CU unlock (24 -> up to 40) is NOT a firmware feature; BC-250-X applies it at OS level per-board. Image does not exist yet - entry is planned, and bc250x pray refuses until the sha256 is real and the catalog is signed.
entries.name: Fanalogy BIOS - P3.00 Nirvana Preset (Flash & Pray)
entries.unlocks: 8 cores / 16 threads (firmware); CU unlock is OS-level
